collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS - VILLAGE MOMENTS (VFX-01..12, draft for the owner, 2026-11-18)
Songs, chants and speeches, a long lazy afternoon, rain on the way, a roof patched with cloth: small moments where the whole village does something together, and the island answers.
Written in the style of the owner's own events. Edit anything and send it back; nothing ships until you approve.

collection.description: A hole in the roof: patch it with a bolt of cloth, or with leaves.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: The roof of the hut the builders are working on has a hole in it, and the rainy season is coming. (subject) suggests stretching a bolt of cloth over the frame, the way the sailmakers do, so the builders can keep working dry. (friend) says cloth is too precious to put on a roof.

o1.name: Outcome A
o1.text: They stretch the cloth tight over the frame and lash it down at the corners. The builders work through two storms underneath it without losing a day.

o2.name: Outcome B
o2.text: They thatch the hole with leaves instead. It leaks a little, and the builders grumble, but the cloth stays in the store for something else.
